notes.title: "LIFE" not found; - Engine Update
notes.notes:
This update replaces the old game version with the new version of the game made with the Godot Engine. There is no new content, this is just a recreation in the Godot Engine.

Although there is no new content yet, I did add some Quality of Life additions. Some of them being:

 Right Click now closes apps
 You can now close apps by clicking on its icon again, when this is possible its icon will be visibly highlighted.
 You can scroll in Grammer, Tweeter & Diary using WASD, the arrow keys and the Mouse Scroll Wheel.
 Audio Sliders for volume control.
 Quick access to the Cursed Diary from the Unlocked Prohibited folder.

I will be making another announcement / life update post here on Steam & in my Discord server soon, probably by the end of this week.  

That's all! Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary Patch
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Background Icon would disappear after Settings Menu was closed, that's now fixed.

Quality of Life Changes
- The game now doesn't close itself after jumpscares, only after the first jumpscare, because... L O R E
- The game doesn't close itself after the "Slightly opened white door" puzzle area.

#1 Anniversary post will come later today, so I'll keep this short. Thank you for your continued support throughout this year!

If you encounter any bugs, glitches or other issues with "LIFE" not found;, please let me know as soon as possible! You can find me the Discord Server. Otherwise, feel free to send a mail to support@berch1n.com.
